description:
FILED s541a (Opus agent, 2026-11-16) from the CPAN board's RUN-PHASE measurement (#4791; docs/cpan-runtime-comparison-s541.md, the per-file table baselines/board-runtime-s541.tsv, the instrument tools/board-timing.pl --run).  Code c1fe4930 (MAIN-READY-97); timings on a quiet box (heavy.sh bench, best of 3, load < 2), scratch in the s541a worktree scratch/s541a/.

WHAT: late requires (use_ok / require_ok, `require` in a sub, a module's own run-time require) load from the module cache: validate the entry (its manifest's dependencies resolved and stat'd again) and load the fasl.  Profiles over the run (scratch/s541a/prof-c1fe4930/): Pod-Simple JustPod01.t -- 91.6 % under p-load-module-cached, %p-load-module-fasl 78.5 %, sb-impl::query-file-system / truename / unix-realpath 25 %; Log-Log4perl 040Filter.t -- %p-manifest-at 24 %, %p-cache-manifest 19 %, %p-dep-moved-p 18 %, %p-shim-lib-dir-p 14 %, %p-child-inc-dirs 14 %; HTTP-Tiny 160_cookies.t -- fop-load-code 21 %.  The same validation runs for compile-time `use`s (load phase, s540a's measurement).

BOARD: PCL's run-time requires 8.01 s, perl's (CORE::GLOBAL::require timed, a separate run) 2.03 s; TimeDate lang.t and HTTP-Message's request / message tests are the largest single files after the string evals.

DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (TAKEN, scratch/s541a/micro/m-latereq.pl, listbench.log): 19 core modules required in a sub at run time (warm cache, best of 3): perl 1.07 ms a module, PCL 14.4 ms (13.5x).  Split it next: the same with the validation short-circuited (a scratch redefinition of the validity check that answers T) shows how much is validation vs fasl load.

LEVER candidates: memoise per process the resolution of a dependency path (truename / realpath are system calls per dependency per module); validate a directory once per run; for the fasl load itself, see whether the fasl's top-level forms do avoidable work (p-defcell / package creation).  Size: one session for the validation half.
subject: PERF: a module first `require`d at RUN time costs PCL 14.4 ms against perl 1.1 ms (19 modules in a sub, warm cache) -- the cache entry's VALIDATION (truename / realpath / %p-dep-moved-p / %p-manifest-at per dependency) and the fasl load; 8.0 s of the board's run vs perl's 2.0 s for the same requires, 278 files / 25 dists
